BiblicalUsage: Paul warns that whoever eats the bread and drinks the cup of the Lord unworthily is guilty of the body and blood of the Lord. The adverb names the manner, not the man: taking the Supper lightly, without discerning what it is.
TheologicalSignificance: One adverb in one warning carries no system of its own; its weight is Paul's, that the Lord's Supper is not a common meal to be taken carelessly.
